title: Police investigate shooting that wounded man in Syracuse
summary: Syracuse Police Department responded to a shooting incident on October 16, 2026, in which a male victim arrived at Upstate University Hospital with a gunshot wound around 6:15 p.m. The incident is under investigation by Syracuse police.
processing_notes: Victim identity not disclosed in article; limited incident details provided in initial report
